issue: #1d / #12 — outcome of the pre-registered kriged-prior test

outcomes.statement: CygOB2-B's median fitted A_V falls by 0.2-0.5 mag
CygOB2-B's fitted upper-main-sequence age RISES above its repair_v3 value of 2.818 Myr
outcomes.note: the new interval reaches 3.981 Myr, the age at which the WP5 mass function independently passed its gate in provenance/wp5_tilt_vs_age_diagnostic_execution.json; the WP4/WP5 age conflict closes without either being tuned to the other

outcomes.statement: CygOB2-A and CygOB2-C ages and extinctions are essentially unchanged (A within 0.05 mag, C within 0.15 mag)
the WP5 residual tilt for B flattens (replacement trend statistic |T| falls below 2)

headline: Two independent, separately pre-registered mechanisms account for CygOB2-B: the single-age injection truth model sitting on the PMS/Henyey fold (fixed in repair_v4) and an anchor-prior extinction-scale error (fixed in repair_v5).  repair_v5 is the FIRST version whose baseline passes for all three subgroups under BOTH the incumbent and the better-calibrated replacement trend statistic.  Branch grid 26 -> 38 of 54 (37 under the replacement statistic).

cells_changing_v4_to_v5_under_replacemen.note: 11 of the 13 gains are CygOB2-B, the subgroup the change targeted.  Two of the three losses sit at trend p = 0.040 and 0.048, inside the indeterminate band around the 0.05 threshold that issue #11 identified and that criterion R3 has not yet resolved.  The third, CygOB2-C MIST R_V=3.5 alpha=2.0, is a genuine max-residual failure at 3.25 and is NOT a threshold artifact.

gate_G3_strict_reading.statement: Under the strict per-branch reading adopted on 2026-07-27, G3 still fails: three A/C non-baseline cells regress.  WP5 therefore remains unaccepted and downstream_wp6_authorized stays false.  The science question that blocked WP5 for four repair versions is resolved; what remains is the threshold-boundary problem of issue #11 plus one genuine non-baseline failure.
